finding: No single component explains warm multi-key binding cost. Deep table assignment is the largest isolated component, but one-node sampler construction is also material and is unnecessary on a warm registry hit.
next_action: F-AHL35 should add a semantics-preserving warm exact-key lookup path that constructs the authoritative one-node sampler only after a cache miss. Provider/cache table ownership remains unchanged.
nonclaims: Component timings are microbenchmarks and are not application speed claims.
F-AHL34 makes no pointer or cache ownership change.
